newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 1c to 566c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls 1c to 566c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator fell by one cent to 566 cents a kg clean at sales in Sydney and Adelaide on Thursday, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices were mixed, with the 19 micron indicator slightly cheaper.
The 20/21/27m categories were 1.0 percent cheaper while 22/25m were slightly dearer. The 23m category was 0.5 percent dearer, 24m was 1.0 percent dearer and 26m unchanged, WI said.
In crossbreds, 28m was 0.5 percent cheaper, 29m 3.0 percent cheaper, 30m 2.0 percent cheaper and 31m 1.0 percent cheaper.
Cardings were mixed, with lambs generally unchanged, locks up to 1.0 percent dearer and crutchings generally unchanged.
WI said Japanese and Chinese interests were principal buyers with support from Taiwan and most sectors of the trade.
Of the 25,760 bales offered in both centres, 9.8 percent were passed in.
Sales continue next week in Goulburn, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 103,200 bales to be offered.
